text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position in opening and repeated stance throughout","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a definite argument early and keeps returning to that position so the reader always knows where it stands."},{"evidence":"paragraph on sensors and safety risks, then paragraph on possible benefits","quality":"organization","description":"The essay develops its claims in a more orderly sequence, separating reasons, counterpoints, and conclusion into distinct parts."},{"evidence":"mentions sensors, driver alertness, and liability concerns","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay uses more article-based details to support its argument rather than relying mainly on general statements."},{"evidence":"addresses what supporters might say about helping drivers in emergencies","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges an opposing view and responds to it instead of only repeating one side."},{"evidence":"links driverless cars to future technology and practical uses","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay explains its points with more developed reasoning, showing how the article’s information supports its conclusion."}]}
